subject.title: RFC: Skill routing metadata and evaluation hints for Harness-style OpenClaw setups

question: Should ClawHub standardize a small advisory routing and verification metadata contract, and if so should v1 expose only normalized raw metadata or also provide server-ranked candidates?
rationale: The field set, cross-package namespace, trust semantics, and ranking boundary affect public manifests and API compatibility; source inspection cannot determine the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Advisory metadata v1
options.body: Define a small optional and versioned field set, expose normalized raw values through API and CLI, distinguish author claims from scanner facts, and defer ranking to consumers.

options.title: ClawHub ranking service
options.body: Add the metadata plus a server-ranked candidate endpoint, accepting additional quality-scoring, abuse-prevention, and compatibility obligations.

options.title: Keep routing external
options.body: Do not standardize new registry fields yet; require Harness-style consumers to derive candidates from descriptions, existing metadata, and their own indexes.

recommendation.title: Advisory metadata v1
recommendation.body: Define a small optional and versioned field set, expose normalized raw values through API and CLI, distinguish author claims from scanner facts, and defer ranking to consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest available history across the existing skill metadata schema, parser, security evaluator, tests, and UI.
